messages:
emily: quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — we saw two repeat patterns: TTL unit mismatch after cluster moves, and missing audit events during bulk rotates. need owners, short mitigations for prod, and a compliance-ready audit export.

raj: i can take the audit/export side. plan: run a batched redis scan to capture tokens with TTLs outside [10,2592000] seconds, group by service owner, and produce a CSV with key, ttl, last-write-timestamp. will add an alert if anomalies exceed baseline by 3x.

helen: i'll own the runtime fix. will normalize TTL writes at the library boundary (seconds-only), add a validation that rejects out-of-range TTLs, and gate behind feature flag `AUTH_TTL_SAFE`. will open PR and attach CI tests that simulate mixed-version writes. target: PR by 2026-04-02.

ops-oncall: drafting a short emergency playbook: 1) run raj's audit CSV; 2) if total anomalies > 1500 -> automated rotate with 24h grace window; else manual targeted rotate; 3) enable `AUTH_TTL_SAFE` in canary (10% for 2h) then ramp; 4) verify audit events for each rotated token and store proof; 5) update runbook with TTL unit note and redis checks. scheduling a 30m prep call tomorrow.

emily: created follow-up ticket SEC-4990 (normalize TTLs + audit + runbook). action owners and dates: HELEN (runtime PR + tests) due 2026-04-02; RAJ (audit script + CSV + alerting) due 2026-03-30; OPS-ONCALL (runbook + prep call) prep call 2026-03-27.

raj: sample audit snippet i'm iterating on:
```
# batched TTL anomaly export
redis-cli --scan --pattern "auth:token:*" | xargs -n100 | while read batch; do for k in $batch; do t=$(redis-cli ttl "$k"); if [ "$t" -le 10 -o "$t" -gt 2592000 ]; then echo "$k,$t,$(redis-cli object idletime $k)"; fi; done; done > anomalies.csv
```
I'll optimize for scale and post results to SEC-4990.

helen: PR opened https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/3902 — includes TTL normalization, validation, and a feature flag. added `ci/ttl-unit` test. linking SEC-4990.

ops-oncall: prep call on calendar. adding weekly 20m follow-ups for 6 weeks to track regressions. also added runbook step: if audit finds >1000 anomalies, coordinate rotate and capture proof artifacts in secure storage for compliance.

emily: please update SEC-4990 as tasks progress. i'll run a 7-day post-deploy check on 2026-04-11 to review auth errors and any unexpected rotate fallout.

sec-bot: SEC-4990 status updated — owners assigned (automated).

emily: final request — add one-line runbook note: "TTL must be written in seconds (s) across all writer binaries" and include raj's audit snippet. mark done here when runbook updated. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
